ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.09 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.09 experimental RimWorld 1.7 prototype: 366 confluence recipe rows, 30 awakening stones, 12 reusable power effects, innate starter powers, and universal pawn targeting for targeted abilities. Requires Essencebound.Core.dll in 1.7/Assemblies. Use test saves and report errors.
